about: The tractus of the formulary “Queenship of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Rejoice, O Virgin Mary; alone you have put an end to all heresies. You who believed the words of the Archangel Gabriel. Still a virgin, you brought forth God and man; and after childbirth, O Virgin, you remained inviolate. O Mother of God, intercede for us.
